title: Beverly & Baby Shirley Russell in Garden, 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Beverly and Shirley Russell in Margie's Grand Mother's Dress. 129
description: A charming outdoor black and white snapshot from around 1930 featuring young sisters Beverly and Shirley Russell in a sunlit backyard garden. Beverly stands smiling proudly while wearing a delicate heirloom lace dress that once belonged to Margie's grandmother, while the baby sits alongside her in an elevated wooden high chair. The print features a decorative geometric corner border popular with commercial photo-finishing labs during the late 1920s and early 1930s.
